entities.name: Jovita Neliupšienė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jovita Neliupšienė is a Lithuanian politician and former Chief Foreign Policy Adviser to President Dalia Grybauskaitė who is currently the Ambassador of the European Union to the United States. She was the Chancellor of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 2020 and Vice Minister of Economy and Innovation from 2020 until 2022. Neliupšienė had also served as the Lithuanian ambassador to the European Union from 2015 to 2020.
